concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-article-mastercard-requirements]] - article-level route for Mastercard requirements effective September 22, 2022: a three-to-seven-day reminder only for the stated negative-option digital-good trial scenario, plus subscription-term disclosure and acceptance, post-enrollment communications and receipts, online cancellation access or instructions, the qualified same-PAN subsequent-authorization warning, and the notice window for billing less frequently than every six months.
warnings: Do not generalize the three-to-seven-day reminder beyond negative-option billing merchants enrolling cardholders after a free or low-cost trial longer than seven days for a digital good.

Preserve the article's separate applicability for subscription-model services, memberships, physical products and digital goods; do not collapse every requirement into the narrower trial scenario or broaden the trial reminder to all subscriptions.
Preserve 'certain response codes' and the same-PAN scope; the article does not enumerate the codes or establish a blanket prohibition on subsequent authorization requests.
Preserve the exact phrase 'billed less frequently than every six months' rather than converting it into an unsupported cadence rule.
Do not infer Braintree Marketplace compatibility, SDK/API behavior or current merchant enablement from this article.
